skill.name: character-development-assistant

skill.summary: Guides authors through character profiles, backstories, relationships, motivations, and arcs.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

content.value_statement: Flat characters weaken reader engagement. This skill guides authors through structured profiles, motivations, relationships, and arcs.
actual_capabilities: Collects basic character details before drafting a profile.
Builds physical appearance, personality traits, flaws, quirks, and speech patterns.
Defines external goals, internal needs, fears, desires, and secrets.
Maps relationship dynamics, conflicts, and growth opportunities.
Creates beginning, transformation, ending, and arc type notes.
Provides sample profiles for fantasy and contemporary fiction.
limitations: It does not verify cultural, historical, or medical accuracy.
It relies on the user to provide story context and genre constraints.
It may produce familiar tropes unless given specific originality goals.
It creates writing guidance, not legal or publishing advice.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Protagonist
use_cases.description: Create a complete lead character with goals, flaws, backstory, and a clear change arc.

use_cases.title: Deepen a Supporting Cast
use_cases.description: Give side characters distinct motives, voices, and relationships that support the main plot.

use_cases.title: Repair a Flat Character
use_cases.description: Diagnose missing stakes, weak flaws, or unclear motivations before revising scenes and dialogue.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a character profile for a fantasy protagonist named Mira. She is a young healer with a secret fear of magic.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an Existing Character
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop my detective for a noir story. Include strengths, flaws, speech pattern, formative events, and a positive change arc.

prompt_templates.title: Map Relationships
prompt_templates.prompt: Build relationship dynamics for my ensemble cast. Show conflicts, secrets, growth opportunities, and pressure on the protagonist.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Character Depth
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this character concept for weak motivation, missing stakes, and trope risk. Suggest revisions that preserve the story role.

output_examples.input: A young mage discovers forbidden powers.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a profile with appearance, fears, secret heritage, Academy conflict, relationships, and a self-acceptance arc.

output_examples.input: My romance hero gives advice but avoids commitment.
output_examples.output: The skill develops career, family wounds, contradictory traits, speech style, friend dynamics, and an emotional vulnerability arc.
The skill identifies missing goals and conflicts, then adds backstory moments, relationship pressure, and scene-ready behavior notes.

best_practices: Provide genre, role, age range, and story function before asking for a profile.
Ask for revisions when a trait feels too common or unsupported by backstory.
Use the arc section to connect character change with major plot events.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for only positive traits; flaws create conflict and depth.
Do not accept a long backstory if it does not affect present choices.
Do not use sensitive identities as shortcuts for conflict or villainy.

faq.question: Can this skill create characters from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for basic story details, then builds a full profile.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing character?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current concept, and ask for deeper motivations, flaws, or relationships.

faq.question: Does it write full scenes?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on profiles, arcs, and notes that support later scene writing.

faq.question: Can it help with villains?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define goals, moral logic, wounds, and relationship pressure for antagonists.

faq.question: Is it useful for games or screenplays?
faq.answer: Yes. The structure works for novels, scripts, games, and roleplaying campaigns.

faq.question: Does it check originality?
faq.answer: It can flag familiar tropes when asked, but it cannot guarantee complete originality.
